name: tpc-logistics
description: Full-stack website for TPC Logistics — freight forwarding, warehousing, supply chain, customs clearance and real-time tracking.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server && cp -r client/dist dist
